name: Me and Our Stories
overview: Do you really want to know what's inside? A day is short if you have "Gangnam Signature Makgeolli," a great space with great friends! The vivid stories of experiences told by four people. There are more than one or two places that I can sympathize with even as a simple chatter. Don't pass it over or over again just because I was laughing. I'll punish you right away! An OTT Korean Wave drama that tells realistic experiences of MZs.
